subject: Re: Next steps & evaluation kickoff - Acme / Redwood
messages:
From: James Li <james.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks for the call earlier — good to meet you and Vivek. A quick recap from our side so we're aligned:

- Primary goal: reduce average inference latency for our chat assist feature from ~480ms to <200ms while keeping reply quality stable.
- Target throughput: ~150 concurrent users during peak events (approx 40k tokens/day).
- Data sensitivity: PII in prompts, must comply with our privacy policy and KMS for keys.

Next steps from Acme:
1) Schedule an evaluation kickoff to show a trial plan and agree on success criteria.
2) Share a sample prompt set and a preliminary list of success metrics.

Marissa, can you and your team propose times next week? We're available Tue/Thu mornings PST.

Thanks,
James
Head of Product
Acme Corporation

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James Li <james.li@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acme.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Hi James — great meeting, thanks for the clear recap.

We can absolutely run an evaluation that targets your latency and throughput goals while keeping quality constraints in place. Proposed plan:

Evaluation kickoff (45-60m):
- Introductions & success criteria alignment (10m)
- Trial plan: dataset/prompt set, duration, monitoring (15m)
- Technical deep dive: integration points, data handling, KMS/keys, network topology for private inference (15m)
- Next steps & timeline (5-10m)

Connor (solutions engineer) will lead the technical deep dive. Vivek will be on deck for quantization/throughput recommendations.

Available slots (all PST):
- Tue 24 Nov, 9:00–9:45am
- Tue 24 Nov, 10:30–11:15am
- Thu 26 Nov, 9:00–9:45am

I've attached a short evaluation plan and a sample prompt set template to help seed the discussion. Please pick a slot that works or propose alternatives.

Attachments: 20261120-acme-eval-plan.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
             acme-prompt-set.xlsx (Excel)

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks James — locking in Tue 24 Nov, 10:30–11:15am PST. I'll own the technical segment. A few prep items that will help the call be productive:

- Please confirm whether the trial will run against hosted Redwood API or Private deployment (VPC/on-prem). If Private, we'll need networking details and KMS access pattern.
- Upload a representative sample of prompts (we got the note that you'll upload by Mon). Ideally 50–200 prompts across your common intents; include any system messages and expected output format.
- If you have performance SLAs for tail latency (p95/p99), include those so we can focus tuning.

I'll bring: evaluation checklist, suggested quantization/profile options, and an integration checklist (links in the invite).
